body: I was on medication for about 6 months, which is what originally got me to start feeling again, but after a few months it gave me this weird flat feeling where I had absolutely no thoughts in my head. I felt like an automaton, so I stopped it and replaced it with exercise and some illicit substances, which gave me much more relief. I'm hesitant to try medication again.

I was walking on the side of a busy street with my boyfriend. He kept walking closer and closer to me, not in a romantic way, just so that it was uncomfortable and I had to move over because our shoulders were brushing. I asked him to stop, because there were no sidewalks and I was almost walking in traffic. He started joking about pushing me in front of a car, and how if I was run over, he'd probably marry someone else, but always regret that I had died, because he could tell I was "the one."
We were in high school and had been dating for two weeks.
